name: Split-attention effect
fact: The split-attention effect occurs when learners must mentally integrate disparate sources of information, imposing an extraneous cognitive load that interferes with learning; spatially integrated learning materials reduce this effect compared to spatially separated materials.
grade_basis: Mechanical single-source grade cap (owner rule, 2026-08-10): 1 source -> C+ max, 2 sources -> B- max, 3+ independent sources -> B max, A band only with a meta-analysis or replication in the cited set.
